lessons_used: Sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder) is helpful, averaging +3.0% after noise correction across 3 tests with 2 wins, though 1 test showed no clear effect.
Finish redesigns (finish, redesign) are helpful, averaging +2.5% after noise correction across 2 tests with 1 win, though 1 test showed no clear effect.
Evidence is still thin for new adoption screens and flows (adoption, new_screen and adoption, new_flow) with only 1 test each, both showing no clear effect.
Evidence is still thin for path choice redesigns (choose_path, redesign) with only 1 test, which showed no clear effect.
Predictions are often too high, overestimating actual noise-corrected impact in most tests.
Predictions can sometimes underestimate actual impact, as in round 6 (+1.5% predicted vs +3.1% noise-corrected) and round 7 (+2.2% predicted vs +4.6% noise-corrected).

candidates.title: Existing account pet sync warning
candidates.change: Display a explicit notice on the sign-in screen advising users to sign in with their original account to preserve existing pets.
candidates.why: 8 support tickets reported missing or reset pets after signing in again, pointing to accidental duplicate account creation.

sign_in.hint: Already have a pet? Sign in with your original account to restore your existing pet.

guard.reason: Adds a helpful account restore notice to the sign-in screen within onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: High support ticket evidence for duplicate accounts, low cost copy change.

candidates.title: Interactive pet personality selector redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the friend picker screen with a split layout and interactive choice cards to select pet personality and play style.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate (60.9%) in the entire funnel, showing a need for a more engaging selection experience.

guard.reason: Redesigns the friend picker while retaining its core function of choosing a pet.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has highest drop-off rate (60.9% conv), but complete redesign requires release.

candidates.title: Desktop pet roaming mode selector screen
candidates.change: Insert a new screen before home intro allowing users to choose whether their pet roams screen-wide or stays anchored to the taskbar.
candidates.why: Support emails show post-onboarding confusion regarding controlling and positioning desktop pets after setup.

new_roaming_setup.headline: Desktop Roaming Preferences
new_roaming_setup.body: Choose how your pet moves across your windows.

guard.reason: Adds a valid new preference setup screen inside onboarding prior to home intro.

candidates.score_note: Support mail points to issue, but adding new screens has low historical confidence.

candidates.title: Split screen path comparison layout
candidates.change: Switch the path selection layout to a split layout comparing standard premade pets directly alongside custom pet creation.
candidates.why: Choose path has a 76.2% conversion rate and high mean completion time (514s), indicating user hesitation.

guard.reason: Redesigns path selection layout while preserving options for both premade and custom pets.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long completion time on choose_path step.

candidates.title: Pet generation progress and status tips
candidates.change: Show an active progress status indicator and detailed generation phase tips while waiting for pet creation.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a long mean completion time of 2336s, leading to drop-off if users feel stuck.

waiting.hint: Generating 3D assets and animations for your desktop companion...

guard.reason: Enhances the waiting screen with progress indicators without breaking any base rules.

candidates.score_note: Helps reduce drop-off during 2336s mean waiting step with progress status.

candidates.title: Reorder sign in after pet waiting step
candidates.change: Move the sign-in step to occur right after pet generation completes, directly before the home intro screen.
candidates.why: Past test lessons confirm sign-in reordering consistently improves overall funnel completion (+3.0% average).

guard.reason: Reorders sign-in step to after waiting screen, which is explicitly allowed.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in reordering has high confidence (+3.0% average lift across 3 historical tests).

candidates.title: Pet photo customization studio flow
candidates.change: Introduce a dedicated photo refinement step between photo upload and adoption certificate to adjust lighting and pet color palette.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected pet appearance.

new_photo_studio.headline: Fine-tune Pet Appearance
new_photo_studio.body: Adjust color tones and lighting before generating your custom pet.

guard.reason: Adds a photo refinement screen inside the onboarding flow without removing required steps.

candidates.score_note: Adding new flows has weak historical evidence (+0.7%) and high cost.

candidates.title: Starter pet toy item reward incentive
candidates.change: Add a highlighted welcome bonus banner on the home intro screen granting free starter toys upon finishing setup.
candidates.why: Finish step drops to 71.0% conversion; an immediate reward incentivizes completing the final step.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy explicitly mentions free extras ('Free Starter Toy Pack Unlocked!').

candidates.title: Instant path switch reassurance copy
candidates.change: Update the choose path headline and subtext to reassure users they can change pet paths anytime without losing progress.
candidates.why: High mean path choice time (514s) signals anxiety over picking the wrong option.

choose_path.headline: Select your path - switch options anytime
choose_path.hint: You can always switch between premade and custom pets later in settings.

guard.reason: Updates choose path copy with reassurance without breaking any rules.

candidates.score_note: Simple copy change targeting hesitation time at low cost.

candidates.title: Desktop launch notification alert on ready
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification options on the waiting screen to alert users when pet generation is finished if the app is minimized.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported pets not appearing or app not opening, combined with long average waiting times (2336s).

waiting.hint: Feel free to minimize. We will notify your desktop when your pet is ready!

guard.reason: Adds desktop notification settings to the waiting screen within allowed scope.

candidates.score_note: Directly supported by support emails and long mean completion time at home step.

picked: Reorder sign in after pet waiting step
held_by_harm_budget: Desktop launch notification alert on ready

decisions.title: Reorder sign in after pet waiting step
